thread:
Maya: Hey team — draft for the product launch blog is up: <https://drive.redwood/example-draft|product-launch-draft>. Need a quick pass on three things: benchmark numbers (Owen), hero visual (Sasha), webinar CTA + HS mapping (Liam). Can we lock by EOD?
Owen: On it. Quick Q — can we tighten the benchmark phrasing around cost-per-token? Current '30-50% lower' reads vague.
Maya: Good call. Proposed replacement: `30% median token-cost reduction on streaming workloads, 45% at 8k seq when using prefix caching + quantized pipeline`. Should I add a parenthetical with test conditions?
Owen: Yes, add a short footnote: internal optimize study, p95 latency target 250ms, sequence distribution median 512, quantization int8. Legal will want the source link.
Sasha: I reviewed the hero options. I prefer the interactive KPI panel (option B). Need final SVG and a dark-mode variant. Can someone confirm brand color pair for the gradient?
Maya: Sasha owns visuals. Use brand gradient A (teal->indigo) from the design tokens file. Sasha, can you drop exports to the shared folder by 14:00?
Sasha: Yep will drop SVG + PNG 2x by 13:30. I can also export a 1200x630 social image.
Liam: For CTA + HubSpot mapping: recommend HubSpot form `launch_webinar_signup_2026`, hidden `account_tier` field, UTM campaign `launch_q2`. Post-reg path: immediate confirm, add to list `launch_webinar_attendees`, then workflow -> assign to Growth queue.
Maya: Sounds good. Who owns the post-reg email copy?
Noah: Growth owns copy; I'll draft cadence: immediate confirm, 48h reminder, 24h final, + post-webinar nurture 3 days after. I'll draft in /marketing/email-assets and tag Growth.
Liam: Also propose CTA label `Save my seat` and the form thank-you should include link to the launch blog and a calendar add.
Maya: Can we add a short one-liner about Dedicated (reserved capacity) in section two for enterprise readers?
Noah: Yes please — quick blurb highlighting predictability and SLAs will help SDRs.
Maya: I'll add a 2-3 sentence paragraph and ping Legal for a quick check.
Owen: Small edit request on benchmarks: change 'median' to 'typical median' and remove ambiguous 'pipeline' word. Suggested: `30% typical median token-cost reduction on streaming workloads, 45% at 8k sequence lengths when using prefix caching with int8 quantization.`
Maya: Updated in draft. Adding footnote link to internal benchmark doc.
LaunchBot: Reminder set: final approval sync 16:00 today — participants: Maya, Owen, Sasha, Liam, Noah.
Maya: Final ask — anyone see any blocker to locking copy at 16:00? If not I'll freeze and start publish checklist. :thumbsup:
Noah: No blocker from Growth. Minor request — include a CRO-friendly CTA variant for paid campaigns.
Maya: Noted — will add a short CTA matrix (organic vs paid vs webinar).
Sasha: Dropped hero images and dark-mode SVGs to /design/assets/launch-hero by 13:28.
Maya: Got them, updating the draft now and adding publishing checklist (SEO meta, canonical, GTM snippet, tracking params, assets uploaded).
Owen: I'll do one last read at 15:30 for numbers and a short table for benchmark test conditions.
Maya: Thanks — locking for final sync at 16:00 unless anyone raises a blocker here.
